heroSubtitle: A guide for backpackers and budget travelers
aboutBio: Hi! My name is Claudio. I am a software developer and backpacker.
aboutStory: I have visited 8 countries and 20 cities around the world in three years. I write this blog to share my experiences and help other travelers with the questions I had when planning my trips. I love making my travel dreams come true and hearing other people share their adventures. I hope I can inspire you to discover your next destination.
aboutGoal: My travel goal is to travel around the world in 6 months.
tagline: Guides for backpackers and budget travelers
